title: Star Leap
tagline: Ten glass marbles. One starry board.
taglineZh: 十颗玻璃珠，跨过一片星空。

lines.en: Weekend night. One game of checkers.
Move one step, or jump a marble.
lines.zh: 走一步，或者跳过一颗珠子。

lines.en: Chain your jumps. Fill the far triangle to win.
lines.zh: 可以连着跳；十颗珠子先进对面三角就赢。

lines.en: One jump, another, another — the whole route opens up.
lines.zh: 一颗，又一颗——整条路都通了。

lines.en: Play solo, or share one screen.
Undo and hints are there when you need them.
lines.zh: 悔棋、提示，也都替你想好了。

lines.en: One starry board. Offline, no ads.
lines.zh: 跨过一片星空。离线，无广告。
